answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the walnut of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A saffron of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zenith of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
